outcome: Successful trial of labor after cesarean (TOLAC)
cohort: 551 primiparous women with a singleton fetus weighing ≥ 4000 g, after cesarean delivery at their first delivery
finding: Spontaneous onset of labor, epidural anesthesia, and a history of cesarean delivery due to non-arrest disorders were independently associated with a higher rate of successful vaginal birth after cesarean in women with fetal macrosomia.
